scope: Read/diagnose ONLY setup.replace_skill_copy target ownership at publication and rollback on current native Linux. No repair, installer architecture, old COPYRESOURCE/STAGE gate rerun or native host assertion.
authorization: Current user authorizes reliability/concurrency audit and preserving pre-fix failures; guide directory read-only. Ordinary main publication of scoped reviewed evidence authorized.

prior_results.search: rg report names found no matching public report; read COPY-STAGE-01/COPY-DIRECTORY-01/COPY-RESOURCE-01/INSTALL-RECOVERY-01 detail documents.
prior_results.decision: Prior stage-generation/limits and rollback-no-competitor acceptance exclude target-after-check concurrency. Reuse only source/context, no old measurements or budgets.
prior_results.same_lineage_warning: Not a new budget for COPYRESOURCE01 or prior accepted/exhausted fullsuite/PID/rolecapture branches.

cases: publish claim: after original owned directory moved to backup, create empty destination just before new.rename; require refusal and claimant same dev/inode/empty content
rollback claim: same point, create empty destination then raise controlled EIO without publishing; require claimant same dev/inode/empty content after attempted rollback
normal replacement control: no injected claim/fault; new content present
uncontended EIO rollback control: error before publication; original prior inode and content restored
injection: Patch pathlib.Path.rename only when source.name==new and target==owned destination, delegate every other rename to saved real method; claim via realmkdir, fault via EIO. Four isolated temporary-directory cases; no multiprocess/stress/frequency claims. No source edits.
interpretation: Safety assertion failures are witnesses; expected producer process exit1 is preserved, not called passing production. Independent repeats same frozen4 once and reviews actualsource/raw/environment. Unexpected error or missing schedule invalidates case; stop, do not rerun. Linux-only no Windows/macOS inference.

implementation.procedure: Review exact loaded setup.py and precise Path.rename injection; source hash fixed.
implementation.acceptance: Only exact replacement branch, native realrenames otherwise.

reference_boundary.procedure: Use destination device/inode + names/body; no copied algorithm oracle.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Claimant remains or witnessfail; uncontended success/rollback controls distinguish invalid injection.

inputs_configuration.procedure: Four tiny ASCII skill fixtures, canonical tempfile roots, native platform exact versions.
inputs_configuration.acceptance: No arbitrary real project target or guide write.

raw_data.procedure: Preserve unittest stdout/stderr/exits and JSON state percase in new outputdirectory.
raw_data.acceptance: All4 observed, baseline failures not suppressed; no errors/silent skips.

analysis.procedure: Classify actual inode/content replacement vs error text and comparecontrols.
analysis.acceptance: No inference to rate/cost/fullinstaller transaction/allOS or performance.

contextual_validity.procedure: Independent source/data review and one bounded repeated fixture execution.
contextual_validity.acceptance: Scopeusable only, taskunfinished and alloldbudgets preserved.

runtime_note: Actual delegated review expected, no trusted ReviewSession/resultprovider available. Do not forge native runtime acceptance; historical references remainunknown.
